model_annotation: The image displays two pie charts illustrating the structure of the Chinese grammatical construction "粘合式 'an'" (bonded 'an'). The larger, left-hand chart details the composition of the "an" construction, showing that "单音形容词+单音名词" (monosyllabic adjective + monosyllabic noun) accounts for 229 instances, or 69.39%, represented by a yellow segment. The remaining 30.61% corresponds to "双音形容词+单音名词" (disyllabic adjective + monosyllabic noun), shown in blue, with 101 instances. The smaller, right-hand chart breaks down the usage of the character "的" (de), indicating that it is "只隐不现" (only hidden, not visible) in 81.66% of cases, represented by a large orange segment. In contrast, "的" is "只现不隐" (only visible, not hidden) in 18.34% of cases, shown in green. A legend at the bottom indicates that the blue, orange, and green colors correspond to categories 1, 2, and 3, respectively.
